subject: SI Simulation Workshop: Atlantic Consulting enablement planning
messages:
From: Devon Clark <devon.clark@atlantic-consult.com>

Cc: partners@atlantic-consult.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: SI simulation workshop (proposal + next steps)

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product overview last week — the team here at Atlantic is excited about building a hands-on practice path for our SI consultants to get production-ready on Redwood deployments. We'd like to run a 1.5-day "simulation workshop" (combining a brief solution brief, live lab exercises, and a mock-run customer handoff) for 10 consultants in early Nov.

Goals:
- Validate a repeatable onboarding sequence for SI teams
- Surface common configuration and performance troubleshooting scenarios
- Produce a short playbook and a POA (proof-of-action) checklist our consultants can use in the first three customer engagements

Could you share a proposed outline and any prerequisites you think we should require (cloud accounts, test data, basic infra)? I'm attaching a rough agenda from our side.

Attachments: SI_Simulation_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda stub)

Best,
Devon Clark
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Atlantic Consulting
devon.clark@atlantic-consult.com
+1 (415) 555-0189
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SI simulation workshop (proposal + next steps)

Devon — thanks, this looks like a great starting point. We can definitely run a 1.5-day simulation that mixes briefing + labs + a customer-handling dry run.

High-level proposal from Redwood:
- Prework (remote, 1 week before): short self-paced modules on model variants, quantization tradeoffs, and network topology best practices
- Day 1 (4 hours): Solution briefing, architecture patterns, live demo of Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private fallbacks
- Day 2 (4 hours): Hands-on labs (deployment, KV cache troubleshooting, perf tuning) + mock customer support intercept exercise
- Deliverables: 2-page SI play note, a 10-step POC checklist, and a recordings pack

Prereqs we recommend:
- Access to an AWS account with 1 GPU instance (t3/g4 equivalent) or Redwood trial hosted access
- Test dataset (anonymized conversation logs) and a small prompt set for evals
- VPN/Slack channel for live support during labs

I've looped in Ben (learns ops/runbook) and Jonas (solutions enablement) to scope lab content and own the POA checklist.

Can you share preferred dates in early Nov and whether you'd like the session remote or a blended on-site day? We can also provide a short simulation script for the mock-handling exercise.

Regards,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
